$comment: requires_bootstrap is the newest bootstrap call shape this plugin makes: bootstrap_lib.skill_material (bootstrap 0.138.0), reached through completion.skill_context. The codex text-only mode passes build_codex_exec_argv(ignore_user_config=True), a keyword first shipped in bootstrap 0.146.0, which is the floor. The venv exists for the CLI, not for the library: models.resolve_endpoint() reads layered config through bootstrap_lib + PyYAML, and OpenAI-compatible completion commands require the OpenAI SDK. The standalone Python carries only .pth links and no third-party packages. bootstrap_lib is linked in because config_resolve lives there. Edge to bootstrap_lib.claudx, class REFUSE. Under a claudx session (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_TEST set, the maintainer test harness) ClaudeCliBackend probes nested_claude_args lazily and inserts its --plugin-dir flags into the claude -p argv; without the module the child would load the published plugins against the redirected data root, so the refusal names an absent bootstrap_lib (claude plugin install bootstrap@plugins-kit) and a bootstrap_lib that lacks the claudx module or the symbol (claude plugin update bootstrap@plugins-kit) in distinct messages, each naming bootstrap >= 0.154.1, before any process starts. The artifact stays true because a claudx result is read as produced by the plugins under test, which an uncontained child would falsify, so nothing is produced instead. Outside claudx the module is never imported and no call is made on any consumer path, so the edge adds no requires_bootstrap floor (nested claude children, engine-internals.md).
